subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw solve pre-processing text acknowledgements as a global messages.ackText config, a generic send-and-continue plugin/channel lifecycle hook, or only channel-specific placeholder features?
rationale: The source-level gap is real, but the permanent fix affects core config shape, plugin API semantics, channel UX, and upgrade/default behavior.

options.title: Define Generic Acknowledgement Hook
options.body: Add a default-off send-and-continue lifecycle contract first, then expose config/docs where the contract proves it belongs.

options.title: Add Global messages.ackText
options.body: Implement the requested global config shape directly and require channels to support or document their behavior consistently.

options.title: Keep Placeholders Channel-Specific
options.body: Let Slack, Telegram, Discord, Feishu, and other plugins own visible placeholders independently without a cross-channel core contract.

recommendation.title: Define Generic Acknowledgement Hook
recommendation.body: Add a default-off send-and-continue lifecycle contract first, then expose config/docs where the contract proves it belongs.
